title: Figure 36: contour plot of real component of acoustic pressure, radiating sphere EPW=25
description: ANSYS 12.1 nodal-solution contour plot of the real part of acoustic pressure (Pa) at 1,000 Hz for a uniformly radiating sphere in water (EPW=25 label), showing concentric pressure wave rings from -245 to 1052 Pa. From the BAASS underwater acoustics modeling of UAP-like sound sources.
